title: X-Men 2099 #1 Marvel 1993 Blue Foil Cover 1st Team Appearance Ron Lim
conditionDescription: Blue foil cover bright, with edge and corner wear and small chips along the bottom edge; light spine stress. See photos.
descriptionText:
X-Men 2099 #1 (October 1993), Marvel Comics - first appearance of the X-Men 2099 team. Blue foil cover by Ron Lim and Adam Kubert. Direct edition, $1.75 cover price.

Back cover: Pinnacle '93 NFL football cards ad.

Condition: blue foil cover bright, with edge and corner wear, small chips along the bottom edge and light spine stress (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
